units.content:
Session authentication for the sample app. Owns the SESSIONS dict.

## Repo pointers

- `src/auth.py:1-23` - login/logout/whoami functions and SESSIONS dict

The auth module issues an opaque session id on login and tracks it in the in-memory `SESSIONS` dictionary. `logout` removes the entry; `whoami` returns the username. No persistence.

## Related

- [data-store](../systems/data-store.md) - where session-authenticated users write data
- [entry-point](../systems/entry-point.md) - how the app wires auth in
- Known gaps: no persistence, no token expiry

In-memory key-value store for the sample app.

## Repo pointers

- `src/db.py:1-15` - put/get/delete on the _STORE dict

`_STORE` is a module-level dictionary. No locking, no persistence.

## Related

- [authentication](../systems/authentication.md) - session ids are not stored here
- Known gaps: no persistence layer; data is lost on restart

Sample app entry point. Wires auth and db together.

## Repo pointers

- `src/main.py:1-13` - main() orchestrates login -> put -> get

On invocation, creates an alice session, writes a record to the store, prints it back.

## Related

- [authentication](../systems/authentication.md) - provides the session
- [data-store](../systems/data-store.md) - target of the write
